description: Observed while proving fz-6lf.2 telemetry: one logical macro invocation emitted repeated [fz, compiler2, macro, expanded] events whenever ScopeCode or demanded function-source expansion blocked and retried. Goal: execute each logical source invocation once while its quoted call, source-visible caller scope, definition revision, and retained macro backend are unchanged; retain the immediate expanded root so downstream recursive waits resume without replaying compile-time effects. Signal: adjacent source-publication tests force blocked retries and assert one event per call identity; macro-product tests prove unchanged and equal reproduction reuse the result, while changed quoted input, changed retained backend content, and product retirement invalidate it. Strategy: one World-owned expansion memo keyed by rooted invocation identity and stable caller scope, with a weak reference to the retained backend allocation so the cache cannot keep retired products alive. Function-body expansion excludes its transient __ENV__ splice from source-visible caller identity.
title: Memoize macro expansion across blocked retries
